result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: a duplicate restaurant card appears side-by-side in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The restaurant card 'Green Bowl Poké' (with identical image, '15–25 min' badge, and '€0.90 delivery' text) is rendered twice consecutively in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate items in the 'Fastest near you' data feed or carousel rendering logic so each restaurant only appears once in the list.
